cards.subtitle: Deterministic Game & Virtual Production PBR Material and VFX Sprite-Sheet pipeline evaluation (replacing zero-padded Conv2D with toroidal circular padding across UNet/VAE, decomposing intrinsic flat-lit Albedo/Normal/Roughness/Metallic/Height maps, and generating 8x8 cyclic premultiplied-alpha VFX flipbooks so amortized unit cost c_pbr(u) = c_0 / (1 + u) reaches 0.5000 at u = 1.0, locking C_active / C_pbr = 1.0000x across all 17 stages u in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive zero-padded T2I textures and open-loop video sprites (which leak UV tile grid seams, baked directional shadows, and alpha halo fringes, inflating technical-artist cleanup cost by 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stages) and 64-tile atlas quadrature.

good_fit: Batch-generating 4K seamless tileable PBR materials (BaseColor, Normal, ORM, 16-bit Height) for Unreal Engine 5 / Unity 6 open-world biomes and virtual production stages
Generating 8x8 (64-frame) seamlessly looping 2D/2.5D VFX flipbook sprite sheets (fire, smoke, magic portals, water splashes) with premultiplied alpha and motion-vector maps
Hardware-compressed KTX2 / BC7 / ASTC asset delivery with zero UV border seams or baked directional shadows
not_for: Plugging raw zero-padded Midjourney/Flux RGB images directly into UE5 BaseColor slots without de-lighting or circular border wrapping
Extracting non-looping video frames with black/white background halos into particle flipbooks
